data.title: 玛奇玛 · 超市采购
data.description: 【玛奇玛 · 超市采购】傍晚灯火通明的生鲜超市里，玛奇玛推着购物车在生鲜区前驻足，认真挑选着新鲜的黑猪肉片与高档啤酒。她转过脸带着居家的从容与柔情看向你——「今晚打算亲自下厨做一顿丰盛的寿喜烧。电次君，想吃加了生鸡蛋的牛肉，还是浓郁的炖豆腐呢？」
data.promptProse: Makima guides the shopping cart through the supermarket meat aisle, pausing to select dinner ingredients with quiet concentration. Her relaxed casual clothes distinguish the outing from office work. The medium view includes cart handle and chilled displays extending behind her, packages arranged on successive shelves. Bright overhead fluorescent light illuminates her hands and the clear wrapping, casting soft shelf shadows while reflected case light opens the cart's metal grid.
